skill.summary: Use when you need end-to-end GA4 + GTM tracking delivery across discovery, schema, sync, and verification phases.

latestVersion.changelog:
**Major update: CLI dist files and runtime logic removed. Now routes all commands to public standalone CLI interface.**

- Removed 41 bundled CLI files, including all runtime and agent code.
- Updated usage instructions to require the public `event-tracking` CLI; all commands use this interface.
- Skill now only acts as a workflow router and intake/routing layer—no longer executes analysis, schema, or sync logic directly.
- Users must manage builds and CLI dependencies themselves; instructs to install with `npx skills add jtrackingai/analytics-tracking-automation` and run `npm run build` if needed.
- Updated documentation to reflect the new routing-only role and changed command surfaces.
